messages:
Aisha (new-hire): hi everyone, I'm Aisha on infra team. trying to finish kube onboarding but my kubectl only shows my local minikube context
Aisha (new-hire): ran `kubectl config get-contexts` and see only 'minikube'. need access to namespace team-recs-dev in the shared cluster. who handles kubeconfig/RBAC?
Aisha (new-hire): when I try `kubectl get pods -n team-recs-dev` I get: "Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "system:anonymous" cannot list resource \"pods\" in API group "" in the namespace "team-recs-dev""
Marco (eng-infra): welcome! :wave: pinging Sam and Priya. we usually either provide a merged kubeconfig via the onboard-cli or create a temporary SA.
Marco (eng-infra): Aisha, did you run the SSO merge step (`rbac-sso-setup`) from the quickstart or just manually merged files?
Aisha (new-hire): followed the mac quickstart but I think I skipped the SSO merge. I do have an active AWS SSO session though.
Priya (devex): hey Aisha, welcome! updated flow: run `onboard-cli kube merge --team team-recs --env dev --out ~/.kube/config` then `kubectl config use-context redwood-team-recs-dev`. if that doesn't work tag @Sam and we'll grant temporary access.
Sam (sre): for a fast unblock I'll create a temporary service account with namespace-scoped edit rights and give you a kubeconfig. permanent access is via RoleBinding for the `devs` group.
Sam (sre): @Aisha what's your GitHub handle for audit and do you only need edit access in team-recs-dev?
Aisha (new-hire): github: aisha-k. yes, just edit in that namespace for now.
onboard-bot: Reminder: missing SSO merge? file the quick access form https://redwood.internal/onboard/kube-access to automate the ticket.
Sam (sre): created SA `aisha-temp-sa` in team-recs-dev and dropped a kubeconfig at `/tmp/aisha-kubeconfig.yaml`. test with: `KUBECONFIG=/tmp/aisha-kubeconfig.yaml kubectl get pods -n team-recs-dev`
Aisha (new-hire): confirmed - can list pods and port-forward. thanks Sam! :tada:
Aisha (new-hire): follow-up: who do I CC for permanent RoleBinding and how long is the temp SA valid?
Marco (eng-infra): CC infra-access@redwood.com with your GH handle + justification. Sam, prefer the access form for trace; infra can approve RoleBinding once request approved.
Sam (sre): I'll extend the temp SA 48h. create the access request and tag Marco and Priya. we'll add you to the devs group after review.
Priya (devex): noted; I'll update the onboarding quickstart to emphasize the SSO merge step and add the KUBECONFIG test snippet. I'll post the doc link in #docs.
Aisha (new-hire): filing the form now. thanks everyone :pray:
Marco (eng-infra): welcome aboard Aisha, holler if anything else blocks you.
Sam (sre): SRE: resolved. :white_check_mark:
